_comment: Hermes agents that receive skill installs and updates. Edit this file, not the deploy script. `python3 deploy.py --list` shows status; `python3 deploy.py <skill>` delivers to every enabled agent. `authoring: true` means skills may be EDITED there and pushed back — see contribute.py and CONTRIBUTING.md; every other box is install-only and its local edits are overwritten by the next deploy.

agents.name: justins-mac-mini
agents.notes: Development box and source of truth. Skills are authored here; deploys originate here.

agents.name: hermes-windows
agents.notes: SENTINEL host. NetBIOS name 'Hermes'. Six profiles, eleven cron jobs.

agents.name: jj-amd
agents.notes: Tailnet hostname is amd-jj-canvey, NOT jj-amd. RTX 5090 32GB — runs larger local models than any other box. SSH user is Justin@, not justi@.

agents.name: jj-hp-prodesk
agents.notes: SSH username is 'user' (the Windows default), NOT an estate name. No system Python and no py launcher: only the Microsoft Store alias stub, which prints an install advert and exits 9009 -- use the Hermes venv interpreter in 'python'. Naming: Tailscale DNSName is jj-hp-prodesk, OS COMPUTERNAME is DESKTOP-1H61R6I -- both are this one machine, on the local LAN (192.168.0.107). Do not confuse it with 'jack-prodesk' (100.101.106.68): a separate physical unit that shares this box's COMPUTERNAME and MachineGuid because both were cloned from one image. BIOS serial 8CG74119J9 distinguishes this one.

agents.name: jack-laptop
agents.blocked_reason: sshd is LISTENING and the box is online on the tailnet (port 22 open, verified 2026-08-30), but every username is denied: publickey,password,keyboard-interactive — tried justi/Justin/justinjohnson/justinjohnson256/jj/hermes/jack. Tailscale SSH is NOT enabled on this node (no advertised host key), so the tailnet identity cannot be used to bypass the key. TO ENABLE, either: (a) append the mac pubkey 'ssh-ed25519 ...Hi3MXt hermes-macmini' to C:\ProgramData\ssh\administrators_authorized_keys on that box, or (b) run `tailscale set --ssh` there to let the tailnet authenticate. Then confirm the username, set enabled=true, and run deploy.py.
agents.notes: Online and reachable on the tailnet; only authentication blocks it. Hermes presence unconfirmed. Tailnet owner shows as justinjohnson256@.

agents.name: jack-prodesk
agents.notes: SSH username 'user'. A SEPARATE PHYSICAL MACHINE from jj-hp-prodesk despite identical COMPUTERNAME (DESKTOP-1H61R6I) AND identical MachineGuid 524c361b-dd7f-404d-bee1-acad5754aa5e -- both were cloned from one image on 2025-07-24 without sysprep. Proof of distinctness: BIOS serial 8CG7346029 here vs 8CG74119J9 there, different SSH host keys, different LANs (192.168.88.22 remote site vs 192.168.0.107), both online at once. IDENTIFY BY BIOS SERIAL OR TAILNET IP -- hostname and MachineGuid are both useless for telling these apart. Same no-system-Python trap: only the Store alias stub, use the venv interpreter in 'python'.
